basic_info.description: This iconic San Francisco Spanish-Mediterranean stunner is filled w/charm & character. This 1920's home is situated in a fantastic location close to the excitement of Ocean Ave. Brick staircase leads you into a foyer, inviting you to the bright living room w/bow double paned window & wood-burning fireplace. Formal dining room has large casement windows & contemporary lite fixture. Redesigned, kitchen is highlighted by new cabinetry, tiled backsplash, Quartz countertops, stainless-steel appliances, white farmhouse sink, coffee bar w/butcher block counter, & recessed lights. Hallway w/coat & linen closet & full bath w/stall shower, tile floors, modern light fixture & vanity. 2 bedrooms on the the main level. 1 room has large sliding door to access to the expansive deck w/views. Pantry area w/staircase, descends to the parquet floored lower level & into the laundry room w/washer&dryer, & backyard access. Ensuite w/full bath is just off the laundry rm, while a 4th rm could be a home office. Backyard includes stone patio & Acacia tree. 1-car+ garage houses a workbench & storage area. Ocean Ave. offers restaurants, bakeries, coffee shops, & Muni. Centrally located to City College, Balboa BART, I-280, Stonestown & SF State University. Make this move in ready home yours for the Holidays!
